final: WITH s AS (SELECT c.state_county_province AS st, COUNT(a.account_id) AS n FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), sh AS (SELECT st, n, n * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(n) FROM s) AS share FROM s), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM sh) SELECT SUM(n) AS combined_account_base, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT a FROM av)) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM sh WHERE share > (SELECT a FROM av)
